working_definition: Author type 'T4d' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 4 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a downwards direction (Henning et al., 2022).

justification: 'T4d' is the exact label or an exact synonym of FBbt:00003735 'T4d neuron'.
